description: Sends a quote request from the signed-in homeowner to one escrow-enabled contractor and returns a request_id. This shares the homeowner's name and the project details (title, description, ZIP, timeline, budget) with that contractor and starts a RateDeed conversation with them. It does not charge anything or commit the homeowner to hire. Before calling, show the homeowner the contractor and every field that will be sent, and get their approval; ask again if any detail changes. Only contractors with escrow_enabled=true can receive requests. Use a new idempotency_key for each new request and reuse it when retrying the same one; after a timeout or error, call get_request_status without request_id to check whether it was sent before retrying. Requires a linked RateDeed account (scope quotes:write).

budget.description: The homeowner's target budget range, if they gave one.

contractor_slug.description: Slug of an escrow_enabled contractor from search_contractors.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per request (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key never sends a second request.

project_description.description: What needs doing: the problem, rooms or areas, sizes, materials. Do not include phone numbers, emails or payment details.

project_title.description: Short title, e.g. "Replace leaking kitchen faucet".

timeline.description: When the homeowner wants it done: asap (24-48 hours), 1-2-weeks, 1-month, flexible.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property.

name: submit_quote_request
title: Send a quote request
